answer: **GO enrichment is not computable from the supplied inputs (no GO annotations, no network)** — verified twice (pre-run and again at runtime inside the script). Therefore no GO biological process term can be honestly named as "most enriched"; no term was fabricated. The executed DE analysis (supporting evidence) shows a clear disease-vs-control transcriptional signature: 197 significant genes (padj<0.05; 135 up / 62 down in disease), with the strongest up-in-disease genes CNTN4 (log2FC +4.52, padj 1.5e-07), VANGL2 (+2.91, 4.6e-09), GNAO1 (+3.49, 2.0e-06), LUZP2 (+3.63, 9.8e-06), FRRS1L (+3.84, 2.0e-05), and strongest down-in-disease PI16 (−4.81, 1.9e-05), STMN2 (−3.83, 3.9e-08), GREM2 (−2.22), STEAP4 (−3.78). A labeled, explicitly non-GO sanity-check ORA on gencode gene_type found up-in-disease genes enriched for protein_coding (122/135 hits, fold 1.19, padj 4.1e-04).
